{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module TokenVault where

import Data.Word (Word64, Word32)
import Data.Int (Int64)
import Data.IORef
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Data.Map.Strict (Map)
import System.IO.Unsafe (unsafePerformIO)
import Data.Bits (shiftR, (.&.))

-- Token vault with withdrawal limits and cooldown periods
data VaultState = VaultState
  { vaultBalances   :: Map String Word64
  , withdrawalLog   :: Map String [(Word64, Int64)]  -- (amount, timestamp)
  , dailyLimits     :: Map String Word64
  , cooldownUntil   :: Map String Int64
  , feeAccumulator  :: Word64
  } deriving (Show)

globalVault :: IORef VaultState
globalVault = unsafePerformIO $ newIORef $ VaultState
  { vaultBalances = Map.fromList [("alice", 1000000), ("bob", 500000), ("treasury", 10000000)]
  , withdrawalLog = Map.empty
  , dailyLimits = Map.fromList [("alice", 100000), ("bob", 50000), ("treasury", 1000000)]
  , cooldownUntil = Map.empty
  , feeAccumulator = 0
  }
{-# NOINLINE globalVault #-}

-- Fee calculation: 0.1% fee on withdrawals, minimum 10 tokens
calculateFee :: Word64 -> Word64
calculateFee amount =
  let baseFee = amount `div` 1000
  in max baseFee 10

-- Compute remaining daily allowance
-- Returns how much more the user can withdraw today
computeRemainingAllowance :: String -> Int64 -> VaultState -> Word64
computeRemainingAllowance userId currentTime vault =
  let dayStart = currentTime - (currentTime `mod` 86400)
      limit = case Map.lookup userId (dailyLimits vault) of
                Just l  -> l
                Nothing -> 0
      todayWithdrawals = case Map.lookup userId (withdrawalLog vault) of
                           Nothing -> []
                           Just logs -> filter (\(_, ts) -> ts >= dayStart) logs
      totalWithdrawn = sum $ map (\(amt, _) -> amt) todayWithdrawals
  in if totalWithdrawn >= limit then 0 else limit - totalWithdrawn

-- Validate withdrawal against cooldown and daily limit
-- The critical check: compare requested amount against remaining allowance
validateWithdrawal :: String -> Word64 -> Int64 -> VaultState -> Either String ()
validateWithdrawal userId amount currentTime vault = do
  -- Check cooldown
  case Map.lookup userId (cooldownUntil vault) of
    Just cooldown | currentTime < cooldown -> Left "Account in cooldown period"
    _ -> Right ()
  -- Check balance exists
  case Map.lookup userId (vaultBalances vault) of
    Nothing -> Left "Account not found"
    Just bal | bal < amount -> Left "Insufficient balance"
    _ -> Right ()
  -- Check daily limit: remaining allowance vs requested amount
  let remaining = computeRemainingAllowance userId currentTime vault
  -- Safe: both amount and remaining are Word64, no sign confusion
  if amount > remaining
    then Left "Daily withdrawal limit exceeded"
    else Right ()

-- Pure state transition: validate then produce updated vault and net amount.
-- Kept separate so it can run atomically inside atomicModifyIORef'.
applyWithdrawal :: String -> Word64 -> Int64 -> VaultState
                -> Either String (VaultState, Word64)
applyWithdrawal userId amount currentTime vault =
  case validateWithdrawal userId amount currentTime vault of
    Left err -> Left err
    Right () ->
      let fee = calculateFee amount
          netAmount = amount - fee
          currentBal = case Map.lookup userId (vaultBalances vault) of
                         Just b -> b
                         Nothing -> 0
          newBal = currentBal - amount
          newLog = case Map.lookup userId (withdrawalLog vault) of
                     Nothing -> [(amount, currentTime)]
                     Just existing -> (amount, currentTime) : existing
          newVault = vault
            { vaultBalances = Map.insert userId newBal (vaultBalances vault)
            , withdrawalLog = Map.insert userId newLog (withdrawalLog vault)
            , feeAccumulator = feeAccumulator vault + fee
            }
      in Right (newVault, netAmount)

-- Process withdrawal with fee deduction.
-- Uses atomicModifyIORef' so the validate-and-update is a single atomic
-- read-modify-write, preventing TOCTOU races between concurrent withdrawals.
processWithdrawal :: String -> Word64 -> Int64 -> IO (Either String Word64)
processWithdrawal userId amount currentTime =
  atomicModifyIORef' globalVault $ \vault ->
    case applyWithdrawal userId amount currentTime vault of
      Left err            -> (vault, Left err)
      Right (newVault, n) -> (newVault, Right n)

-- Batch withdrawal: process multiple withdrawals atomically
batchWithdraw :: String -> [Word64] -> Int64 -> IO (Either String [Word64])
batchWithdraw userId amounts currentTime = do
  results <- mapM (\amt -> processWithdrawal userId amt currentTime) amounts
  let (errs, successes) = partitionResults results
  if null errs
    then return $ Right successes
    else return $ Left (head errs)
  where
    partitionResults [] = ([], [])
    partitionResults (Left e : rest) = let (es, ss) = partitionResults rest in (e:es, ss)
    partitionResults (Right s : rest) = let (es, ss) = partitionResults rest in (es, s:ss)

-- Admin function: set cooldown after suspicious activity
setCooldown :: String -> Int64 -> Int64 -> IO ()
setCooldown userId currentTime duration = do
  modifyIORef' globalVault $ \vault ->
    vault { cooldownUntil = Map.insert userId (currentTime + duration) (cooldownUntil vault) }

-- Query functions
getBalance :: String -> IO (Maybe Word64)
getBalance userId = do
  vault <- readIORef globalVault
  return $ Map.lookup userId (vaultBalances vault)

getDailyRemaining :: String -> Int64 -> IO Word64
getDailyRemaining userId currentTime = do
  vault <- readIORef globalVault
  return $ computeRemainingAllowance userId currentTime vault
